nodes.name: Triggered by Hub (nps.promoter_flagged)
nodes.notes: Star topology S6.9: replaces 'Daily 11AM' independent poll. Hub-Dispatcher calls this once per client on event_type = 'nps.promoter_flagged' (same event Module 6.7 subscribes to -- both spokes react to it independently). This ONLY covers the link-generation half of this workflow; the Daily 12PM reward-check flow below is untouched, since the plan's S6.9 doesn't cover it (it's a conversion-poll, not a promoter hand-off -- see README).

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE id = {{$json.client_id}} AND id NOT IN (SELECT referrer_client_id FROM referrals);

nodes.name: Fetch Flagged Promoter Without Referral Link
nodes.notes: S6.9: was a bulk 'promoter_flag = true AND NOT IN referrals' poll; now a single-row lookup by the client_id in the Hub event payload. The NOT IN referrals guard stays as an idempotency check (don't re-generate a code if this client already has one).

parameters.jsCode:
const code = `NIVY-${$json.id}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase()}`;
return [{ json: { ...$json, referral_code: code, referral_link: `${$env.NIVY_SITE_URL}/?ref=${code}` } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO referrals (referrer_client_id, referral_code, status, created_at)
VALUES ({{$json.id}}, '{{$json.referral_code}}', 'link_generated', now());

parameters.jsCode:
const raw = $json.response; let p; try { p = JSON.parse(raw); } catch(e) { p = { subject: 'Know someone who could use our help?', body: raw }; }
return [{ json: { ...$('Generate Referral Code + Link').item.json, email_subject: p.subject, email_body: p.body } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT r.*, cm.name AS referred_name, cm.status AS referred_status
FROM referrals r
JOIN clients_master cm ON cm.referral_code_used = r.referral_code
WHERE cm.status IN ('Won', 'Paid') AND r.status != 'reward_pending';

nodes.name: Fetch Referrals with Closed-Won Conversion
nodes.notes: Assumes clients_master gets a new referral_code_used column, populated when a lead lands via ?ref= (integration point in Module 1.3/1.4 -- not modified here, needs a small patch there to capture the query param).

parameters.query: UPDATE referrals SET status = 'reward_pending', converted_at = now() WHERE id = {{$json.id}};
